{"id": "de5c25c8-c965-4658-b371-c379b7b6d92f", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Confirmed — here's the distinction:

- **The default VPC** (the one AWS auto-creates per region in every account) always gets **172.31.0.0/16**, with its default subnets carved into /20 blocks within that range.
- **A custom VPC** you create yourself doesn't have a fixed default — you pick the CIDR block yourself, anywhere from **/16 (largest, 65,536 IPs) to /28 (smallest, 16 IPs)**.

So if you meant the auto-created default VPC, it's 172.31.0.0/16. If you're creating a new one yourself, you choose it at creation time.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
